title: ASK A QUESTION
music: Quiet, uneasy documentary underscore. Soft felt piano with slow sustained cello, 75 bpm, restrained and serious, no vocals, no percussion build, steady bed under narration.

segments.narration: Pay-own-yuh, Colorado. September twenty twenty-five. Deputy Treasurer Kaja Bowman asks the mayor how staff can raise a concern about the town administrator.

sfx.prompt: soft knock on a wooden office door

segments.narration: That same day, the mayor gives Stefen Wynn her name. Write-ups dated that week land in her personnel file.

sfx.prompt: manila folder dropped onto a desk, papers shuffle

segments.narration: Twenty-three days later, she is fired. Wynn, in his own words: we just terminated without cause so she could get unemployment.

overlays.text: “We just terminated without cause so she could get unemployment.”

sfx.prompt: cardboard box of office items set down heavily

segments.narration: The HR help? An Indiana firm Wynn reached out to while in Indianapolis. No bid. The town paid in full for an employee handbook that, months later, the board still had not seen.

overlays.text: “Stefen, I hope that you are enjoying your time in Indy?… Thanks so much for reaching out.”
overlays.by: New Focus HR to Wynn, May 23, 2025

sfx.prompt: heavy rubber stamp pressed onto paper, single hit

segments.narration: And the staff kept leaving. Both public works directors quit. The finance office, fired within weeks. Seven departures in a year.

sfx.prompt: soft deep cinematic boom hit, short

end.source: Sources: Delta County Independent (June 30, 2026); Town of Paonia board packet June 10, 2025; Town M365 audit logs (CORA C 26-12, C 26-35)
